body:
After one bottle of the divi scalp serum, my two balding spots on both temples of scalp grew baby hairs! Instantly, I noticed that I only shed a few hairs compared to almost the whole shower wall covered in hair on hair wash days. I was struggling with sudden hair loss due to stress and going through grieving and my Aunt recommended me this. She was also experiencing the same thing as me and swears by this product. Due to my grieving, I had lost about 75% of my hair. I was also experiencing weekly, my scalp would be sensitive to the touch, felt as if I was touching a bruise and was very red. title: Quite surprising!

When I went to my hairdresser after about 6 weeks of use, she didn't notice any hair growth yet, but my hair was resistant to color (been coloring my hair for years, & more so since my hair has gone from blonde to white). This was unexpected. I continued using the scalp serum, but stopped using it about 10 days before my next hair appointment, since my hair dresser thought perhaps an ingredient in the serum might have contributed to the resistance to color. At my next hair appointment, by hairdresser was amazed at the new growth (after another 6 weeks)! But, the most surprising development is that my hair has started returning to its natural color, with some even darker color growing in! I had thought that my hair color was retuning in the very front of my hairline, but wasn't sure until my hairdresser confirmed it. She even took photos with her phone over different parts of my scalp, so I could see the hair growing in - wow, what a difference! Even though I had stopped using the serum for a time, my hair was still resistant to taking color - the new growth is different in that respect. But my hairdresser was able to figure out a way to make the color work; she's very knowledgeable in her profession. I'm very excited & surprised to have these awesome results, & I will continue using the serum to see how my hair continues to grow!

DIVI Scalp Serum Review: A Refreshing Boost for Your Scalp Health

I’ve been using the DIVI Scalp Serum for a few months now, and I can confidently say it’s a solid addition to any hair care routine—especially if you struggle with scalp buildup, irritation, or hair thinning.

✅ Pros:
Cooling, refreshing feel: The menthol gives an instant tingly, clean sensation without being too harsh.

Noticeable scalp improvement: My scalp feels less itchy and dry. After consistent use, I noticed less flakiness and some reduced hair shedding.

Lightweight formula: It’s not greasy or heavy—dries quickly and doesn’t affect my styling routine.

Clean ingredients: No sulfates or parabens, and it contains helpful ingredients like caffeine, tea tree oil, and peptides.

⚠️ Cons:
Scent might not be for everyone: It’s a mix of minty and herbal, which I personally like, but it’s strong.

Takes consistent use: You won't see instant hair growth—it’s more about long-term scalp health.

Price point: A bit on the higher end for a 1.7 oz bottle, especially since you use it daily.

Final Thoughts:
If you're looking to invest in your scalp health and possibly improve hair growth over time, DIVI Scalp Serum is worth a try. It's more about prevention and scalp maintenance than an overnight miracle. Stick with it for at least 4–6 weeks to see real results.

title: Best to use in the morning
body:
While I absolutely love this product and was initially looking for one with caffeine, the stylist that had me switch to this product said it contains no caffeine and recommended using it at night.  I gave it a try and saw results.

The thing I didn't like that I found out today is that because it contains caffeine,  I was unable to sleep.  Not falling asleep until 8:30 am is a problem.  It had negative impacts on my health.  Last night I forgot to use it out of sheer exhaustion (two to three low quality sleep hours a night takes a toll).  I finally slept and decided to look up the ingredients this morning.  I was shocked to find all three products contain caffeine, which has been proven to increase hair growth similarly to minoxidil in studies.  

I was even more shocked to see that your own website says it doesn't matter if you use it morning or night.  This is incredibly irresponsible marketing!  Lack of proper sleep interrupted by caffeine intake (that can be absorbed through your scalp) can cause harm.  In addition to health challenges, someone who isn't getting proper rest can have poor job performance or be a danger when operating machinery, like a car!  

I would rate five stars, but due to irresponsible marketing practices and poor education you get four.  Does it work, absolutely.  Is not sleeping and negative health consequences worth it, no.  I experienced lack of sleep, which led to mental clarity challenges, exhaustion, weight gain, and increased anxiety.  Please correct your marketing and make people aware of the potential harmful side effects of your product.  I as a lay person knows this, you as a product should as well.

body:
This product is getting ALL THE STARS!! 
I’ve been struggling with scalp psoriasis for years now. Then to add to that I recently lost some weight (on purpose) and I am struggling with thinning hair pretty bad right now. I bought Divi about 3 weeks ago randomly because I found it in ulta. I was looking for something that would help with thinning hair and also help with hair thinning. I had a feeling j was going to have to get 2 different products for my issues and was worried that one product may work against the other. Little did I know I would stumble upon DIVI. I was reluctant to buy it at first because it is rather expensive but I’ve made a promise to myself that I will invest in me!! I also looked at the ingredients and all the stuff in it is what is in hair oils. So with all the research I’ve done I knew that if a product that has tea tree oil, eucalyptus, rosemary, peppermint and a lot of other GREAT ingredients that it would help relieve the itchy burning scalp m, while at the same time helping my hair thinning! So I bought it! I couldn’t wait to get it home and use it. I walked straight in the door and read the instructions and every word of the packaging and got busy applying it. Almost Instantly, I got the tingly, cooking affect and was instantly relieved of the burning and itchiness!!! I also have been trying not to wash my hair as often. I was worried that this would make it even more oily but as soon as I felt the serum I knew that it was actually going to help with my already oily scalp. I can’t truly and honestly say weather it helps with hair growth yet because I’ve only been using it for 3 weeks now, but I’m super stoked to find out the results of that! So in conclusion, I HIGHLY RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT for ANYONE dealing with “scalp psoriasis”, “eczema on the scalp”, “dry scalp or dandruff” even people with an oily scalp that are wanting a scalp serum to help hair growth!! I’m sorry this review is so lengthy but I truly hope that this review finds someone who is at their wits end who is struggling like I have been who just simply wants to feel good about their self and that they are encouraged to buy this product by my review because I have finally found something that truly helps me feel better and I’m stoked about it! 

Thanks for reading! And also THANKS TO DIVI for creating a wonderful product! I will most likely try other products too! But I know I for sure will have this in my bathroom to be available as long as I have the money to spend on

title: BUY THIS
body:
I don’t think I’ve ever left a review for a product, but I rely on them heavilyyy… so, after using this product on and off for over a year (inconsistencies only caused by a move, travel, and good ole depression), I think it’s time I pay it forward to those who also look to reviews for guidance/decision making

1. I have sensitive skin (eczema & acne) and have tried other popular, high(er) end serums in the past, and they’ve allllll made my forehead and scalp breakout like crazy (places I actually never tend to get acne). Even months after discontinuing these products, my skin would not let up, which concerned me bc it’s almost as if the other products imbedded themselves into my biology for an unhealthy amount of time (idk how else to describe it lol). It was so frustrating bc I’m not trying to trade in one ailment for another!!! Thankfully, this one doesn’t do that and never has! 

2. This shit WORKS. I’ve always had thinner hair and’ve been insecure of my hairline… never ever did I think that at the age of 28 I could successfully alter my hairline! It’s taken a bit of time, and I’ve learned that consistency is key, but nevertheless after 3 months of staying on top of it, the new growth is insane! 

3. This is actually a great hair styler.. my scalp/hair is naturally oily, but this product not only doesn’t contribute to that at all, it actually makes my hair look and feel cleaner and fresher! Doesn’t matter if I apply it when my hair is still damp from a shower, or the next morning when my hair is fully dry, it makes make hair appear voluminous, bouncy, soft, and subtly shiny in a non greasy type of way. Which I love because it only makes me want to use it more consistently! Plus, I don’t have to worry about how I time its application and that’s incredibly convenient for someone like me who struggles with routine

All in all, this product is really working, it looks great in the process of working, and has no negative side effects (for me, at least, which is huge bc I swear I’m the type to fall into that 1% of people who experiences side effects when using most products…)

title: Worst Customer Service Experience
body:
I am so disappointed and angry with the customer service experience I had with Divi. I was so excited to use the products and now I will never use the products nor buy them again. 

I ordered a shampoo, a conditioner and a serum to my address in Mexico because it clearly said in the website that they send to Mexico - all fees etc included. I have a Us address that I’ve ordered to before but since I live in Mexico and I’m not traveling soon to the Us and it said that they deliver to my doorstep then I chose ship to Mexico. 

A few weeks had passed and I hadn’t received any updates so I wrote to Divi about the status of my package. They answered immediately (Rashida to be exact) and was given all the info - perfect. I didn’t mind waiting as long as I got my products. 

Then last week I get a call from Fedex saying my package was retained by customs and they won’t deliver my package. I have 2 options 1- send it back to Divi but I need to pay $50 aprox or abandon the package. Ridiculous so I wrote to Divi and I was sure they would help. But how wrong was I… 

We wrote back and forth a few emails and to sum it up Divi said “sorry for the inconvenience, once we ship its not our problem, you need to contact the shipper directly, we’ve never had this problem before, etc..” how is this possible? How can you say you ship to Mexico and then this happens? I didn’t choose the shipper DIVI DID… If you say you deliver to a place you make sure the client received their package and the work isn’t done until they do. 

I tried to resolve the problem with Fedex but since Divi is the one who sent the package they are the ones who need to authorize any changes - example: send to another US address. I asked them to help out and they never did. So my package is now considered abandoned. 

So not only did I throw away my money but I never got my products or will ever get my products and got the worst customer service experience from Divi. 

Once again I am so so so disappointed! I was so looking forward to using the products (postpartum hair loss) and now I will never buy from Divi again. You lost a client and cared very little. Didn’t even try to help. 

Now all I hope is that you take off your webpage that you deliver to Mexico because you clearly don’t deliver to Mexico. You took my money and I ended up with none of my products. 

As I said in one of my last emails- thanks for nothing. You stole my money + received the worst customer service experience ever.

title: Beginning of my Divi journey.

After my hair started thinning on top immediately after Covid this past summer I went on a hair repair journey.
I researched, added biotin/collagen in my diet as well as healthy habits all together. I even used a well known hair loss program. Unfortunately that one did more damage to my hair by severely drying it out. I recently was @my hairdresser salon (who btw sales high-end Hair Growth item's) and she told me about one of her clients using Divi and she couldn't believe her "Hair Growth" from using it in 2 months! My hairdresser was blown away and recommended me to try it. 
So,, I just received the whole set 3days ago and I'm using all 3. Shampo,Conditioner,Scalp Serum. 
First off I already see more Body in my hair after first use of Shampoo & Conditioner. 
I'm very pleased w/the size of these 2 items they're actually really big. 
The serum I purchased 2 w/the BOGO 50% off 30ml 
W/the serum it was very easy to apply. 
I did NOT however get the "Tingling" feeling I see on other reviews. I did get That feeling with the Bosley System however. But I quit that system after 4months due to drying out. 
Hopefully that tingling feeling or Not doesn't mean my Divi Serum is not working, LoL. 
I did /do however get the "Cooling feeling from the Eucalyptus in the Conditioner & Serum, that's normal. 
I'm all in 100% with the Divi program for the suggested 90days. But, if I don't see even a "Slight" difference in hair growth, 
I won't spend another penny on it. 
I don't hang my hard earned money on any sale that doesn't bring me the satisfaction I set out for. 
In this case "Healthy Hair "Growth". It's the reason I purchased it. 
I did notice a high % of reviews I just read were PP User's. So that made me a bit nervous because I had my child 20yrs ago and didn't lose any hair! In fact my hair was at it's Best during My PP. Hopefully it's for all types of hair thinning. 
Fingers 🤞
*I'll update month 2

I use 3/4 a dropper as instructed, but every month so far have ended up finishing the bottle a week before the month is over. I ended up finishing the 3rd bottle in the middle of the month so wasn't using the product for over 2 weeks until my subscription shipped again. I don't know why it hasn't been enough if I'm told to use 3/4 of the dropper. Especially for how much you're paying you'd think there'd be enough product for a month. I'd also like to add, although I love the glass bottles, it pains me every month to throw the bottle away. I wish they would combine the 3 months into 1 bottle so it's not so wasteful. I never brought it up to him because even i didn’t know what was happening at the time. One day he asked if i was “okay” because he noticed more hair in the drain. What a wake up call. At the same time, i discovered i had scalp psoriasis. Not dandruff. Stress related-scalp psoriasis. Like how do i fix that? No medicated treatments or high-end shampoos could touch the damage. It seemed every trial of shampoos, conditioners, treatments, etc. just made it worse. Adding on to the stress-related hair fall. Then DIVI. I have followed Dani for years and i thought “okay one more shot to my months/years of fails. But maybe she knows”. Not greasy? Great! Cool calming feeling of the serum? Love it…but does it work? I WISH i had taken before pics because it is WILD. I have hair growing on my scalp that i haven’t had since idk..ever? I showed my husband hair today on my temples that i don’t even remember existing. When i blow dry my hair, there are these 3 inch hairs all over, just flowing around like crazy flyaways-but i know are NEW. New hairs that should have been there all along. It doesn’t make sense. It shouldn’t be possible with all the things I’ve tried. But it’s real-new hair. And the scalp psoriasis? Down 90%. And i don’t say that lightly. I want to post a thousand 5 star reviews because my life, beauty, and confidence has changed. It seems small, but i hope women like me read this and have hope. Thank you a MILLION and more.

A few other random thoughts:
• Love the smell & actually love the tingly feeling!
• Don’t love the dropper. Aesthetic:: 10/10. Practicality: 4/10. I have such a hard time getting the serum in the dropper, especially when I’m running low in the bottle. Also, even when it’s completely full I can NEVER get it to fill up more than 60% of the way. 
• Speaking of which, the directions in the marketing & branding are a little confusing — are you supposed to use an entire dropper or 3/4, because I’ve seen both?
• I love applying it on towel-dried hair vs. dry hair — I felt like it made my hair greasy applying it dry (I have very fine hair, however).
• The price is a tough pill to swallow + it’s a very tiny bottle. That being said, I’d literally pay anything to get more hair growth.

I hope it works out for me but after 30-days of not really seeing anything, I’m not sure I’ll be buying it again. I am going to give it the full 90-days like they suggested before deciding if I’ll buy more. I really do hope it’s not just an Instagram fad & that this works. I love Dani and her family! title: It works, but not enough product for the money.
body:
The product itself is great, however the packaging itself is not. We understand trying to be luxury, but we consumers are mostly average joes who are desperate for hair growth. Cut down the cost by making the packaging less extravagant. We could care less about what it comes in, all that matters to us is the product itself. You could send me this stuff in a plastic baggy and I’d still use it. Yes Divi works! However, due to the price, the small amount of product you actually get, and the lack of discount codes/sales they advertise, I unfortunately won’t be purchasing again. I thought since Dani struggled so badly with hair loss she would make it more affordable for people like her. Almost $60 (once shipping is paid for) for a half full bottle that is already so small doesn’t seem so reasonable and we’re on the higher end of middle class. We love Divi, we love Dani, but we don’t be purchasing again unless something changes. 

After reading multiple reviews + Facebook comments I know that many agree with this.

I’m so excited to see the results I will have in a couple months! I literally never leave reviews for anything because tbh I’m just lazy (big love for my peeps who do leave reviews tho because I AM the type to read every single one before purchasing, so I appreciate you!!) but I had to for Divi. title: Breastfeeding/Pumping Mommas Beware - PEPPERMINT
body:
I want to start out that this is not a knock against the product simply meant to be an informative review for those of us pumping and breastfeeding mommas in this time of formula shortages.

Peppermint oil decreases/dries up your breastmilk supply. I am a Postpartum/Neonatal Registered Nurse and have been an essential oil consultant for 9 years, I don't have hard data to reference only my personal experience and what I have heard from the lactation RNs I work with. During one of my first EO classes my classmate forgot to mention she was still breastfeeding and after testing one drop of peppermint oil on her hands she went home and pumped half of her normal supply. 

My sister introduced this product to me as a birthday gift as we are both postpartum and I was starting to experience the hair loss. I am not sure how I missed the peppermint in it when I checked the bottle but I did. My sister has been using this product for several weeks now and experiencing an "unknown" plummet in her supply. I have blessedly only been using it for about a week and have been taking breastfeeding supplements. I have noticed a slight drop in my supply and originally thought it was due to my menstrual cycle starting back up. However, after coming online to order more I saw the peppermint oil part of it. I haven't used the product long enough to have seen actual results which is why I am not giving it 5 stars but do enjoy the feel and smell of it so much that I plan to give it another try once I stop breastfeeding and will write another review then :)

title: Liquid Gold
body:
I'm not one to gush, brag, or talk up products - but y'all. This serum is liquid gold. I don't know what secret ingredient makes this so amazing (unicorn tears?), but it is SO amazing.

Full disclosure. I went into the process super skeptical. I'm a more 'mature' mom, and had succumbed to the idea that aging meant hair loss. I thought this product would be great for the post-partum mamas who had short term hair loss and needed a boost, not the mature mamas like me who were just getting old. But in a fit of desperation, I ordered a bottle and I will never look back. 

I wish I had taken before/after photos because the results are unreal. Areas of my scalp that were borderline balding are now full of baby hairs that just continue to grow. I had taken on the necessary habit of back-combing my scalp to keep my fine, thin hair from looking like it was stuck to my head - but now? Now I don't have to. Now it is so full - and thickening - that I don't need to take that step in my normal routine.

Also - having fine, thin, and oily hair - I was super concerned that it would make my hair greasy, which would in turn make it even more flat. 

Not the case. If anything it makes it feel more full. 

I can't say enough good things about this magical elixir. If you are on the fence - jump off. Buy this. You won't regret it for a second. I'm a three-month at a time subscriber, so I don't ever get close to running out. Try it for one month. I promise you'll be happy.

title: Game Changer!
body:
I’ve always had thin hair my entire life. I wore semi-permanent hair extensions to thicken my hair and after three months I had them taken out since they became very painful. I noticed worsening in hair thinning and some mild bold spots where the tension from the hair extension was greatest (as pictured below). I decided to try Divi in January 2022 to repair the damage. The first couple months I was using it heavily and going through 2 bottles a month. Immediately after trying the product I loved it, but waited to post a review to see if there were results. The first time I put it on, it felt like someone was slightly playing with your hair and smelled like a salon! Within within a couple weeks, I already noticed improvement in my hair thinning and it felt like my hair was somehow thicker. After 3 1/2 months, I noticed a substantial increase in hair growth around my hairline and no more bald spots! I’ve given my mother a vial to try as she also suffers from hair thinning and hair loss, and she too has seen an improvement. My boyfriend asks me to put it in his hair every night because he absolutely loves how it smells and feels. 

Overall this is an incredible product that has eased my anxiety regarding my hair thinning, while also making it a good way to decompress at night with how relaxing the product smells and feels. The only negative of the product is that I feel the bottle is a little too small. To adequately saturate my scalp, it usually takes a couple bottles a month. Since I’ve seen great results, I’ve decreased my usage to using it twice a week verses daily to save on cost. The promo codes provided definitely helps with affordability I just wish the vials were larger. To save on the product I typically bundle with three. The photos below were the results from mid January 2022- April 30, 2022.

title: WOW, just wow!
body:
I want to start by saying that I know *now* that my worth is not found in the thickness or length of my hair, but it wasn’t always that way. For years I struggled with fine, brittle, won’t grow past my shoulders hair—it is the way I was born. For those reasons, I cut my hair short through most of my early 20s. I wanted people to think that I like my hair short; that having short hair was my choice. Thankfully, with time, among many other things (including Dani’s immense vulnerability in sharing her own hair struggles a few years ago) I’ve grown to be grateful for the hair that I have even though it might be on the thinner and shorter side. Believe me though it was not easy. I’ve taken many steps to improve my hair health over the last several years and I was thrilled when Dani shared her mission behind DIVI. I’ve been using DIVI for about two months, and I’ve noticed massive improvements in my overall scalp health (less dry, flaky, an extra day between washes[!!!]) and I’ve notice a lot of growth around the edges of my face. 

I’d also like to add that as someone who struggles with thin hair, I also struggled with greasy hair (thankfully, some changes to my hair care routine have allowed me to better manage this). Having greasy hair was one of my biggest insecurities, if not my biggest insecurity. In fact, throughout college and even after I washed and styled my hair every single day, sometimes twice a day if I had evening plans. My biggest concern with DIVI was whether or not my hair was going to become oily/greasy after using the product — not even a little bit. I am shocked. Truly. DIVI is unmatched, and unlike any other scalp or hair health serum on the market.

Dani’s mission behind creating DIVI is clear, and I am so happy to be a part of it. To Dani & the rest of the DIVI team, THANK YOU for furthering the confidence I have in my hair, while simultaneously helping me strengthen, grow and nourish my scalp and hair. I’m *so so* grateful.

After two months of using divi, I have to say I really feel like it’s made my hair worse. I feel like I’ve thinned out in front (where I’ve concentrated the vials the most), and my hair just doesn’t fall like it used to. It feels more like I’m trying to cover things up. 

I get everyone’s hair is different and one person is not everyone, but I felt like I had to write my experience, especially after seeing all the before and after pics of men with amazing new growth (many of which supposedly only take place within a few weeks). Yes, a serum can help with texture and thickness (and probably has for many people), but I really feel misled and like it’s disingenuous to post such drastic pics as if this is a miracle cure or the equivalent of rogaine when I don’t think it is by any means.

It seems so silly to allow something so vain to consume my life, but for all my fellow hair loss ladies and gents I am sure you too can attest to this depressing situation, it was a difficult time to say the least. My loved ones cannot believe that Divi has turned my whole situation around, even my hair dresser is in disbelief, but most of all I have not felt this confident about my hair since I was diagnosed with UC in 2016. 

Thank you Dani, Divi has so positively changed my life you will never know just how much! You are a literal angel on earth.

Here is some information on the actual serum:
* It smells incredible and tingles a bit so you know it's the good stuff and is doing it's job! I had an enormous amount of ingrowns which I know is yucky buttt as we know that means that it was working! My follicles are being activated again, it works! 
* It never leaves my hair greasy and you only need a bit! 

Lastly, If you are at a loss with what to do to improve your hair growth, strength or health (yep it makes it shiny again, I promise), this is your sign to have faith in Divi (and not tomorrow, but now)!

title: This is NOT for people with sensitive skin. BAD REACTION.

First and foremost, it pains me to write a negative review, but with that said I feel like I need to warn others with sensitive skin. 

I really wanted to like this product. I waited months to finally make the decision to get it. I was suffering from postpartum hair loss and really wanted my hair to grow back. I started using the product in the middle of my scalp for the first 2 washes - everything was fine. On the 3rd time, I decided to strategically target the hairline around my face where I had the most thinning from postpartum. The next day, the skin on my face around my hair line was red, inflamed and extremely irritated. I put some moisturizer and aloe to try and calm my skin. In the middle of the night I woke up and my face was itching like crazy. I had to put prescription steroid cream on my face to try and treat the rash, irritation and redness the serum had caused. My skin around my hairline has been itching and peeling for 2 weeks since my last use of the product. I really wanted this to work, but this was just not worth it. 

Separately, I had to email twice in a 5 day period to get a response. I am hoping the company can work through their customer service issues to get back to their customers in a timely manner.

title: This stuff is liquid gold!!!
body: I've always had lots of thick, wavy textured hair... until Covid. I suffered some incredible hair loss from Covid. I had a pretty bad case and was hospitalized for 5 days. Just shortly thereafter I was also diagnosed with hypothyroidism...DOUBLE WHAMMY! My hair was coming out in massive clumps. And I was devastated because my fiancé and I get married later this year. I was so afraid I'd be bald or have to find a wig. And good wigs aren't cheap! And cheap wigs aren't good! LOL I had seen this hair serum before, because I follow Dani Austin on Instagram and have for years, so I knew her struggles. Another influencer shared her mother's results with it and I was blown away! The difference was amazing. I dove in head first, buying one bottle and then deciding to just go for it and buy the 3 pack. I'm so glad I did! I've used this for 2 months now and my hair has grown INCHES! Not only are the thinning spots filling in and my baby hairs are little teenage hairs, but the length is longer by at least 2 inches if not a little more. I will never be without this! If you're questioning it, just go for it. You will not be disappointed. I keep it on my desk since I work from home, so I'll remember to use it. It's got the best cooling, refreshing feeling and the BEST part... it does NOT leave your hair greasy!! I've trained my hair to be washed twice a week and I can use this repeatedly and it doesn't effect the oil level in my hair. I think that's the reason I held off from ordering it for a bit, because the advertising I saw for it initially was an oil formula in the dropper. Washing my hair less often than most that kind of deterred me from ordering until I saw it on Instagram as a watery, milky serum that's not oily at all. I'm serious, this stuff is a GAME CHANGER!! I wish I had pictures I could post but sadly I was so embarrassed I haven't taken a picture where you could see the thinning in quite some time.

title: 10/10 DIVI IS A LIFE SAVER!
body:
You guys! I am 26 years old and have a 7 month old who was born with CDH. He was in the NICU for 45 days. As you can imagine, this pregnancy and postpartum was very HARD. Spending every day in the NICU not knowing if my baby would live or die. When we returned home with our baby (he survived!), my hair started falling out in CLUMPS!!! I was nearly bald. My hair was so thin and you could see my scalp almost everywhere. Naturally I have dark and thick hair. So this was so heartbreaking. My sister bought me DIVI for Christmas. I didn’t begin using it right away because I had no hope that it would even work. Eventually I was like what the heck I’ll try it. I used one entire bottle, I used it all over my scalp, it was gone in about a month. Once I was out, I decided I would look at my hair. I had baby hairs everywhere!!! I couldn’t believe they were actually growing!!! Yes I know that your hair grows anyways but I truly believe this product is my life saver. My scalp feels so much better. It’s not itchy or flaky like it used to be. Not to mention the scent is so fresh and clean and I love the tingly feeling it gives. AMAZING!!! I will literally use this product forever.

title: REALLY REAL AND HONEST REVIEW
body:
Ok..LOTS to go over. First off- I purchased the three month supply because of the DARYLANN code that was being offered at the time and saw a few before and after photos. I figured why not…my covid hair loss put me in the “I have nothing to lose” (except for more hair(cringe)) so I bought it. 
1. Shipping was relatively fast/normal
2. The three boxes of the product came in a plastic shipping bag. 
3. The materials used for the product packaging was nice.
4. (And this is where the 3 stars starts coming in..) the bottles are EXTREMELY SMALL for being a hair serum/product. Like fits in the palm of your hand is SMALLER than your palm type of small. For one bottle to cost as much as 2 bottles of my favorite wine it better be good. 
4. I wish the bottle/container had one part of it that was transparent so you know when you’re running low. 
5. The stopper/applicator was nice! The tip was narrower than the tube so it doesn’t leak out product unintentionally. That’s what she..nvm..
6. If you DON’T LIKE MENTHOL THIS ISN’T FOR YOU!!! The menthol is so so strong. 
your scalp will feel like it just took a swig of listerine for a solid minute or two..or ten. AND it will stay that way for about 30-1 hour or longer depending how sensitive you are to it. 
I probably wouldn’t apply this before going outside in the wintertime either..jk- but maybe not? 
7. I don’t feel like the “one month supply” for the one bottle will actually last for one month. If you use one syringe each time it definitely will not last one whole month. Then your talking possibly $80-ish/month for this serum. But hey if it holds its weight in gold then by all means!
8. I like that it doesn’t leave your hair or scalp feeling greasy or that I even put anything in it at all once it’s dried.
9. I’ve only be using it for a couple of weeks so I can’t report on the actual growth or lack there of, of hair. But will report back on that!
10. I absolutely love Dani, her story, and love following her on Insta. It’s truly incredible and so inspiring to see someone struggle with such an intimate issue and not only overcome/working through her struggles but create something/advocate for so many others going through the same or similar hair issues. I really hope this product helps whoever uses it! And if you’re reading this..I hope I made you laugh or smirk a little reading my very opinionated review.

title: The Good & The Not Great
body:
The good and the bad— but let’s start positive! 
It definitely works. Not as quickly as I wanted but I have been using it for two and a half months now. My husband and friends have noticed how long my hair has been! Not just new growth, but lengthening my hair as well. It’s definitely helped as far as my itchy/dry scalp went. I notice way less dandruff—thank goodness—and my scalp isn’t nearly as itchy (just when I go too long between washes and have a lot of product buildup). I like to use a full dropped pretty liberally around my whole scalp and then brush it through. 

However it’s not all great. I have noticed that it has a crazy strong smell and I’m extremely hesitant to use it in the mornings. body:
I purchased this after struggling with thinning hair around my hairline. One month down and already noticing a difference! Little baby hairs that I can hardly keep up with - just purchased three more months and highly recommend. 

Some things to point out - while it does not make your hair greasy in the hours after applying, it does for a bit after putting it on. Not a big deal as it dries quickly but lots of reviews mention the lack of greasy hair and after using it on dry hair, I can't see that to be true. When applying to wet hair, you can notice that you had it in once it dries but again, not a big deal and am able to style regularly. Either way - don't expect to put this on your head and walk out the door - you'll need sometime to let it sit and then style. I always just put it on before bed. 

The reason for four stars - the constant emails from divi asking for reviews the second that my shipment was received. Clearly I was not going to have any results before even opening the box so not sure what I was expected to review ... well to my surprise, a lot of people were coming on here to write a review after just receiving the box ON THE SMELL. *cue eye roll* 

Buy this and give it a month to work its magic but immediate unsubscribe from the emails.

title: THE LIMIT DOES NOT EXIST!
body:
How much do I love DIVI? The limit does not exist! I have been waiting for this gem to come out since in the last 2+ months I developed undiagnosed hair loss. My hair started falling out in chunks. I am seeing 3 doctors all at once for it, a primary, a derm and an OB (to see if my PCOS is the cause) and they all say that it's temporary Alopecia, that all my blood work is "normal" and that my hair will fall out for 6 months and return to normal and if not then we will look into further reasons. I am trusting the process but losing your hair is really disheartening. I am taking every vitamin imaginable, switched all my hair care products, using other hair oils that leave me greasy and letting my hair dry naturally. My confidence has taken a dump!

I have been using DIVI for only 2 weeks and it's glorious! It dries quickly, smells refreshing and IT DOESN'T LEAVE AND GREASE OR RESIDUE BEHIND! When you lose your hair like this, the last thing you want to do is wash your hair often because that's when we already, naturally lose the most hair - so this allows you to treat it for multiple days and not have the need to wash it everyday.

My hope for future bottles is that a clear strip on the side is added so I can see how much is left in the bottle that I am using BUT I am not sure if that even matters because I'll be using every damn bottle, lol! I am looking forward to seeing the results! Thanks for attending my TED talk :)

title: Works but it takes time.
body: I've used this for over a year now. In the beginning, I had no faith because at the rate my hair was falling, there was no way I could grow any more. I went to the dermatologist and asked if the ingredients in this serum would even work. The doctor said it should work because there seemed to be nothing wrong with it. Everyone's hair growth takes time. I expected results within 3-6 months, but did not see anything till the 8th month. Once the 8th month hit, I saw a bunch of little hairs sprouting from the top of my head. Yes, it's an awkward length, but I would take it over hair constantly falling. I have used it every single day, only on parts that are visually thinning. But as much as this serum worked, it will only work if you change your lifestyle to ensure you aren't purposely making your hair fall. I changed my routine and made sure I took time off to relax. I stopped tying my hair up and let it down most of the time. My family has a history of hair thinning, so I'm glad I started this when I did. I can't imagine myself having bald spots at the age of 20.

title: Works well
body: I received this product complimentary from vegamour and tested it for 3 months in exchange for my honest review. There's a spot on my head of which I have dealt with hair loss practically all of my life. It wasn't until recently that I decided to try some different methods to see if I could regrow some of the area. I started out by using rosemary oil and I did see some results but I wanted to see if another product would give me better, and potentially faster results. So when I received this, I was excited to give it a try. The directions say that you need to apply this serum daily which quickly became impractical. I have fine hair and my scalp can be quick to get oily sometimes. Though the serum is lightweight, with my fine hair, it would often look like it was oily even if I had washed it not long ago. If I wanted to wear my hair down, I would not use this. I usually would only use it on second or third day hair or when I wore it up. After using this product for 3 months, I have noticed a difference in the area I've been trying to regrow and I also noticed some regrowth around the hairline. Overall, though I think the product worked well, I'm not sure that I really noticed a difference in results with this serum in comparison to the rosemary oil I used previously. I probably would not repurchase this product in the future for that reason.

title: Transforming my hair after postpartum
body: Firstly, I decided to use this hair serum because, about a year ago, I had a baby, and the postpartum effects caused extreme hair loss, weakening, and the appearance of bald spots on my scalp. However, after using this serum gifted by vegamour for the past three months, I can confidently say it has made a noticeable difference in both the texture and overall health of my hair. I initially chose this product mainly for its natural ingredients and because it’s vegan, which allows me to avoid chemicals on my scalp. The application method was very easy; I simply applied a few drops all over my scalp before going to bed. The drops have a lightweight texture, don’t leave a greasy feeling, and absorb quickly. However, I did notice that if I went more than two days without washing my hair, it tended to get dirtier more quickly. Since I started using the serum, I’ve noticed a significant reduction in frizz. My hair looks healthier, with less hair loss, thicker, stronger, and, most importantly, fuller. I will definitely continue using this serum to maintain the results and fully restore the health of my hair. I would highly recommend it to anyone looking to strengthen and thicken their hair, as well as reduce hair loss.

title: Life Saver in a Bottle - An Honest Review
body: Long story short, I had a horrible experience coming off birth control (IUD) where I lost half of my hair primarily under my head. My confidence was destroyed, and I didn't realize how much of it came from my once full, wavy mane. Then I found Vegamour; I have been using this product for over two years now. I use the GRO shampoo and conditioner combined with the serum. While everyone is different, it took me about two years to see the full effect vegamour had on my hair. My shedding and hair thinning have reduced significantly where I have little coming out after showering and brushing.  Don't get me wrong, you can notice new hair growth almost immediately after using the serum for a week. But if your goal is to get your hair back to what it used to be, this process will require faith, patience and strength. There were times when I felt hopeless about my hair regrowth journey. But I promise, if you keep up with your hair routine and focus on nutrition, your hair will slowly but surely get back to what it almost used to be. In addition to the serum, I used a silk bonnet to protect my hair at night, ate enough protein, scalp massages and used protective hair styles to reduce breakage which helped a lot. To this day, my hair is still not the mane it used to be, but the difference is incredible compared to when I started using Vegamour. If you are looking for a more holistic way to regrow your hair, this is it. I would recommend this product to anyone. The first three pictures are from Dec 2022 to Now.

title: The hype is real! Vegamour’s GRO Hair Serum transformed my hair.
body:
I started using the Vegamour GRO Hair Serum about 4 months ago after looking for products to address apparent thinning across my hairline and worrisome fallout in the shower. I am F/27.

I have always had fine hair, but a good amount of it. From 16 to 23, I bleached my hair, but I never saw thinning or fallout like I did before trying Vegamour’s GRO Serum. 

Note: I’m also in recovery, so I’ve been free of alcohol, etc., for 2 years; before that, my hair was extremely thin from malnutrition and poor health for about 2 years.

I hadn’t dyed (or even cut) my hair for about 9 months when I started to notice the thinning/fallout. I believe the thinning was a result of hair breakage from pulling up my hair tightly and brushing it while wet.

So, I went online and googled “best hair products for thinning hair and fallout.” I saw Vegamour’s serum listed on an Elle magazine listicle of  “The 10 Best Hair Growth Serums for a Fuller Mane.” 

I also did a deep dive on Reddit, which showed mixed reviews, but I trusted my gut and ordered the GRO Serum. It was one of the greatest beauty purchase decisions I’ve ever made!

I regularly use a Sunny Isle hair mask (currently, using the one with Rosemary & Mint, but all their products have castor oil). I’ve learned castor oil can help with scalp health, dullness, and tangles, but overuse can actually build up on the scalp, causing fallout.

With Vegamour’s GRO Serum, I have been able to balance my castor oil use with a serum that ensures far less breakage. I have baby hairs for the first time ever, and my boyfriend regularly comments that he has noticed more growth around my hairline (which he never thought was patchy before!).

I’ve since learned two ingredients in particular are  central to the GRO Serum’s efficacy: Safflower oil and red clover (though, the serum is packed with other natural compounds that are amazing for hair health and reducing fallout!).

Safflower oil is lighter than castor oil (as well as noncomedogenic) and increases blood flow to the scalp, while also protecting hair from environmental toxins.

Red clover was a surprising secret weapon! I’m from Ohio, which is abundant with red clover up until winter, in many cases. But, I didn’t know that red clover has shown clinical effectiveness for hair restoration because of its isoflavone quality, a component that is similar to estrogen. 

This aspect of red clover blocks a hormone called DHT, which is an androgenic hormone (I.e., “masculine” hormone). DHT is problematic because it shrinks hair follicles and keeps hair from absorbing nutrients, such as those you consume in food and drinks, in addition to those you apply topically through shampoo, conditioner, oils, etc.

Since using the GRO Serum, I have had so many comments about my hair growth and thickness, including family members who are very familiar with my hair’s usual state. 

I love love love this product and recommend it to everyone. My only complaint is the cost, but you get what you pay for, and this is worth the expense! (I also tend to use more than one dropper-full, so I end up purchasing a bottle every three weeks instead once a month, as directed, so that’s my issue!)

Buy the Vegamour GRO Serum if you have thinning hair, fallout, or bald patches; but, also buy it if you have naturally fine or thin hair—it transformed not only my thinning and fallout, but also my natural hair texture/thickness (or lack thereof). 

The first 3 photos were taken before or at the very beginning of my GRO Serum journey. The last 3 photos were taken in mid-August 2024 to about 2 weeks ago (showing progress after consistent use of 3 to 4 months using Vegamour’s serum). 

Thank you, Vegamour!

title: Didn't think it would work...
body:
I'm so glad they're proving me wrong.  I'm old, 63, been losing my hair to stress for the past 10 years to the point you can see my scalp in the sun.  Cannot part my hair either.  

Six months in with Vegamour and, though its not a full head of hair, it is so much more better than it was.  I don't trust chemicals and I heavily color my hair.  My daughter is a colorist and she finally asked me last week what I'm doing because my crown has gotten so much more fuller. title: seems to be working
body:
I got this to try to regrow hair in a scar on the top/back of my head. I had one of three hair transplants and decided not to continue those, so I've just been using an eye shadow-like coloring so you can't see the area. I would prefer more hair, though. I've used Vegamour most days for a little over a month. I've also used on my hairline, and the thinner temple area on my right side.

The scar is filling in. It's still sparse, but it seems smaller, and there's more hair around the scar, which makes for easier covering. My part area shows lots of new growth. I'm not sure if it's working at all on the right side temple area, but that may take longer to regrow. I should say I have also been using the BOOST red light therapy on my scar, so it could be the combination of red light and Vegamour. I started around the same time, but the new growth on my part would seem to indicate at least some of the scar area regrowth is from the Vegamour. I'm not treating my part with the red light.

My only concern is that there DOES seem to be some hormonal impact from the serum. Red clover affects female hormones, and I've noticed if I use too much, it seems to trigger the inflammation of hormonal imbalance. I'm not sure if it's too estrogenic, or just not the right type of estrogen my body prefers, but I get the same achy joints and breast tenderness as if I eat way too much tofu or take too many estrogenic herbs.

I know they say it's not hormonal, but given the red clover and my body's reaction, I don't see how it could be totally non-hormonal. Maybe I am extra sensitive to red clover in particular. I will use it for at least a couple months to see if I can get that scar to regrow more. I'm not sure I will be able to take this long term, as if I use even a little too much, my feet and knees really hurt. It's a fine line, and if I err on the side of perhaps too little, I do fine.

title: Reduces shedding - packaging is annoying
body:
Moving into peri (IYKYK) and it felt like I was shedding a lot more hair than I used to. I've also noticed thinning at my temples and along the hairline. I bought this in the hopes it would help with those things. I've used it for several months now and I can say it definitely reduces shedding - I went from feeling like I was losing clumps washing my hair to only seeing a few hairs in the shower. I'm not seeing new growth or filling in at the hairline, which is a bummer, but my hair does feel fuller and looks really good - lustrous and full-bodied. I haven't had issues with my hair being greasy or oily with this, and I have fairly oily skin/scalp. 

However, the bottles are annoying for multiple reasons. One, the serum basically has the consistency of water and it often runs into my face, ears, and neck, so that feels like a waste. Not sure what kind of applicator would be better but maybe something with a slower release. Two, as another reviewer mentioned, the dropper doesn't work to get all the serum out as you get to the end of the bottle, and it leaves a fair amount in the bottom of the bottle. I wind up shaking it out onto my hands and applying with my fingers, but again, the serum is like water, and it drips off my hands quicker than I can get it on my head. For the price, I really want all of what I paid for.

title: Life-Changing
body:
After a bout of COVID in September '23, I began experiencing rapid hair loss and shedding.
I think I cried more in those few months than I ever have.
The distress of my hair falling out in my hands and my visible scalp made me feel hopeless, and I did not want to be seen by other people.
After checking my bloodwork, my doctors gave me the option of oral Minoxidil (Rogaine) to be taken indefinitely.
I decided to try Vegamour first, and I'm so glad I did.
Not only does the GRO serum accelerate my hair growth, but also their shampoo and conditioner immediately and visibly thickens and plumps my hair.
Their add-on products like the leave-in conditioner make my hair less tangled and more soft and manageable b/t washing.
I am quite sensitive to perfumes and fragrances, and the Vegamour products do NOT give me a headache.
I would encourage anyone who is experiencing symptoms like mine to try Vegamour.
It's now March '24, my hair has completely stopped falling out, I have about 2" of hair re-growth, and finally I'm able to run my fingers through my hair again.

title: Look no further, this is your hair savior.
body:
I started experiencing increased hair shedding in December of 2023. I have Thyroid disease, and thought it was attributed to that.  My bloodwork showed normal levels, except for my stress levels. My dermatologist diagnosed me with telogen effluvium, which is very common (and most common in women.) it’s the body’s autoimmune response to a stressful event, similar to the hair loss effects of post partum. She wanted to put me on minoxidil, but I was hesitant due to negative side effects. 

I did A few weeks of research and decided to take a chance and order the 3-pack gro+ serum, along with the shampoo. 

When I TELL you at what a difference it’s made, it really has. Before I was Experiencing clumps of hair coming out of the shower, when I brushed. Hair was limp and lifeless. I’d try to style it to conceal thin areas, and really just lost all around confidence. Ladies, our hair is our THING, so I know Your pain.  I consistently Use the serum every other day, and use the shampoo once a week. I maybe Have 5-6 strands that fall out when I  shower, compared to the clumps that were falling out some months ago. Consistency and patience is key, so don’t give up. 

Vegamour has been an absolute life saver, and I’m a customer for life!

title: Beyond thrilled!
body: I’m a 57 YO post menopausal woman with Hashimoto’s.  I was getting concerned about the amount of hair that was coming out in the shower. It was alarming! I started minoxidil, but didn’t like the thought of these chemicals on my scalp. I stumbled upon Vegamour, and I’m so glad I did! It aligns with my values as a vegan, and I love that it is a clean, cruelty free product. I started using Vegamour on November 4, 2023 and have not skipped a single treatment. At just a couple of weeks in, I noticed much less shedding, and now at nearly 90 days in, my hair has done a 180 degree change in health and appearance. My front bald spots are filling in, and my hair looks terrific! I’ve never loved my hair, but it now looks as good as it ever has. I have super fine hair that is now past my shoulders. Before Vegamour, it was growing slowly, and now it is growing like crazy! I apply it at night, and have experienced zero greasiness the next day, and I’m fine to keep my normal twice a week shampooing.  I tried to get “before” pictures, but couldn’t get the right angle. My coworkers confirm that my hair is looking great these days. I plan to be a lifelong customer, but I do wish it were a little more affordable.

I think I've seen *some* filling in near my temples and maybe near my widow's peak but can't be completely sure. Flaking, irritation, insane oiliness and itchiness to the point that it was embarrassing to be in public. I had to wash my hair every day and tried so many different products that would only leave me with scabs (TMI, sorry) from how much I itched. My dermatologist offered absolutely zero help, but using Vegamour shampoo and conditioner plus this serum has fixed everything.

Now I can go a few days without washing like I prefer to with the shampoo and conditioner set. I noticed an almost immediate difference in the health of my scalp. I don't itch whatsoever since I started using this either - I can't believe how much it's changed my life. I'm on my second bottle of serum and second set of shampoo and conditioner. I've even been able to use a purple shampoo with no irritation while using this stuff. Going to try every product probably and I'm pretty confident the lessened irritation will help me get some thickness back in the long run!

title: Finishing Bottle 2
body: Currently finishing bottle two and ordered another bottle. I like that the formula is not heavy or greasy and the smell is nice. My hair is filling in, but I’ve also been making a lot of other changes, so I can’t really speak on this product alone. I would definitely say that adding it to your regimen could be worth it though and that if you are struggling with hair thinning or hair loss, you shouldn’t be putting all of your faith in a miracle or single product anyway. I also like the scalp detox sample my subscription growth serum came with. I definitely feel like it helped clean and calm my scalp. I was suffering with major hair loss and found out that it was from a major iron and B12 deficiency after a UC flare and taking anti-depressants for the first time (which I ended up having an allergic reaction to). I used this in conjunction with changing my shampoo/conditioner, hairbands, and wash frequency, adding supplements into my routine, and eliminating almost all soda and artificial sugars. I had long curly hair and was used to seeing a lot come out in the shower, but then it reallyyyyy started coming out. And the same amount would come out even if I washed two days in a row. I started avoiding washing my hair because it would just make me cry. My hair line began to thin majorly to the point where I was trying to think of how I could cover it up at work while still being in dress code. I had to cut my hair and wear it in a low ponytail with satin scrunches in the hopes that it would help take off some of the pressure. I loved wearing my hair down and big and wild, but would only do so when at home and on the weekends because I didn’t want anyone to see how my pale scalp began to show in the back. That was a little two months ago and I’m seeing big improvement!!! I’m hoping to be back to where I was in another month and maybe better another 3.

Due to the results I decided to try the rest of the system including the gummies and shampoo and conditioner. I will say one bottle doesn’t last me a month. I probably use two in a month because I use it in many areas on my scalp. I haven’t experienced any flare ups on my skin or dandruff which I usually experience with other hair growth drops. It’s water based so it appears to be well absorbed and non greasy so I can put it daily as instructed.

title: Great product! Terrible company/ customer service!
body:
Great product, and in my experience has shown quick results. With that, I ordered originally from a third party to “try” the product, and again saw very quick results. 
Ordered a $400+ order directly from the company as a result. Yay! Except…this order was then cancelled without notification, and when I “messaged” customer service I then invested a substantial amount of time and energy rectifying the situation. Additionally, this company deals primarily with women’s hair loss…In my opinion that is a quite sensitive subject. I did not have a “sensitive” experience. I had a scripted experience. And they claimed there was only “1” possible way to ship their product. So, even though they were directly responsible for all of the happenings, there was “no way” to honor the original delivery date.
I guess in the grand scheme of hair loss one would think that a company promoting hair growth would be a bit more sensitive.

I was horrified.  My hair is part of my identity!  I went to the dermatologist and was treated with various topical shampoos and serums.  Nothing made any difference.  I told my sister how much my hair loss bothered me and she bought me some Vegamour shampoo, conditioner, and the GRO serum.  She had heard about it through her work as a massage therapist at a top health spa.  I was skeptical because nothing else had made any difference.  But I gave it a try and was really good about putting the serum on almost every night.  Lo and behold, I began noticing tiny hairs coming out along my hairline and I could tell my hair was getting thicker.  Fallout dropped dramatically.  Seriously, whatever this stuff is I am hooked.  I regret that I did not take any before pictures.  But the change has been real.  I recently returned to work in an office I left 9 months ago and I have had people ask what I've done differently with my hair.  The style is the same.  There is just more volume.  I tell everyone what has made the difference.  A huge thanks to Vegamour!

title: Dissapointed
body: I'm really disappointed in this product. First of all, it's not explicitly clear in the product description that users need to buy multiple products to see any kind of result.  The bottle is tiny - I have been using it sparingly only on the front parts of my scalp for 5 days now and the bottle is already 25% empty. The product is very expensive and I was disappointed to learn that if I don't buy a second and third product, I will have spent a significant amount of money and time for zero results. The product should be sold in a bottle three times this size and priced accordingly, or else it should be made clear that buying one product only is useless. Secondly, I think those contemplating buying this product should know that it does leave your hair looking greasy and crusty (at least it did for me, despite only using it sparingly). I don't usually write reviews but wanted to share my experience so that others aren't deceived like I was.

title: Mixed results, but mostly negative
body:
So let me just start by saying how excited I was to try this serum. I’ve seen the ads for months and months and finally decided to give it a try after dealing with hair shedding and thinning for two years. I thought what the heck, it can’t make it worse right? WRONG! The shedding actually increased by month three , with daily use of the serum as directed. It’s gotten to the point where the shedding is so bad that I have to wipe up the floor in my bathroom after every time I wash, blow dry, or even brush my hair.

 When I contacted customer service they gave me this long winded explanation how this is my old hair falling out to make room for the beautiful new hair to grow in. Well, news flash it is not growing in at the same rate it’s falling out! There is no way I can replace all the hair on my head in a matter of 2 or even 3 months. It takes years to reach a certain length!

Needless to say, I am super disappointed and disheartened. Back to square one. Again.

Their cancellation process is also a joke. You have to call in. Are you serious?! Who does that anymore?

For the little bit of positive in this product: I will say I did see some new hair growth , very fine wisps, in areas which were sparse. But overall the extreme shedding that has not stopped is just not worth this new growth. My hair looks a lot thinner now than when I first started the treatment three months ago.

Also for those of you reading their “clinical double blinded trial” claims. Read the fine print a bit closer: the results were based on an extremely small samples. Just 19 participants for one of the studies. Anyone who has taken statistics should know the sample size needs to be at least in the high 20s for it to be representative of the larger population.

I am skeptical how well this truly works, many of the positive reviews are left by people who received the product for free. Just saying…..

title: On my 3rd bottle
body:
I have had a fair amount of hair loss, I lost about half of my hair due to vitamin deficiencies, anemia, stress, and overall lack of protein in my diet. I lost around half of my hair in the span of like a month or two. And I promise this stuff is the one product I found that actually works. I didn’t want to use minoxidil, that was kind of going to be my last resort. As well as getting a wig. But once I started using this product my hair stopped falling out, and started to grow back, and honestly grows faster than before. After about the first bottle I started to notice little hairs about a quarter inch long around my face. And now that I’m on my third bottle the hairs are about 3 inches long and stand up on end so I can see so many. I have so much regrowth it’s crazy. 

At the very least, I know that my hair is growing a lot faster. Even my coworkers have said that my hair just randomly got way longer. So I recommend this product to a lot of my clients. I am a hairstylist. So if you’re dealing with hair loss this would be the first product I would recommend and honestly the only one other than vitamins. Good luck!

I also added the bondi boost hair grow shampoo to the mix. Because these shampoo and conditioner duos are very expensive for small amounts. I am willing to pay for the groceries them, but I’m not willing to pay that much money for the shampoo and conditioner. I wish it was a little bit more affordable. The drops are worth it, the shampoos should be no more than $20 apiece

title: Wow wow wow!!!
body: If the photos don’t show you how amazing this stuff is, I don’t know what will. I’ve been using this after my hair started falling out from an undiagnosed autoimmune disease. I didn’t notice the hair loss at first but then one day, BAM! I was shedding like crazy and the moment it hit me was when I had to start investing in ball caps to hide my utter embarrassment. I went out to a theme park with my daughter one day and forgot a hat but learned how to hide the bald spots and thinning well will volumizing shampoo, foam, hairspray… but then it rained and my daughter’s face said it all. I wanted to cry so we ran to the nearest souvenir shop and I paid a stupid amount of money for a cap I never wore again. Not to mention the hundreds of dollars a month I spent on hair products, vitamins, gummies… I tried IT ALL! I even went to a dermatologist and was given minoxidil but you can’t stay on that forever.  What I love about this product is that I can go for days not using it and I don’t notice a severe difference in shedding. I’m fact, I would lose clumps of hair daily (200- 250 strands… and yes I counted) and now maybe 50?  I love this stuff so much that I even bought it for my mom and sister who also suffer from hair loss due to the same autoimmune disease. Thank you Vegamour for changing my life and making me more confident on a daily basis!! I’m back with my hairstylist and have even got highlights! Never thought that day would come :)

title: I think it works
body:
So I was in kind of a desperate place a while back because I was extremely vitamin deficient, and highly anemic. And I didn’t know at the time what was causing my hair loss. Until of course I went to the doctor, but when I was in a very desperate state I wanted to turn to about anything. I did decide to land on this product because it had a lot of reviews. I’ve been using it for almost 3 months, and I do see new growth, I know for a fact my hair is growing back. I don’t know if it’s due to the fact that I took care of my vitamin deficiency. Or due to the fact that I’m using this, maybe it’s the combination of both. If I knew for a fact that this product was The source of my new hair growth I would give it five stars, but I don’t know if it’s just a coincidence. But I would say if you’re having hair loss issues, it could be for multiple reasons. But this is a decent product to turn to to try. Because if it doesn’t work for you you really didn’t lose that much money. And as far as places taking advantage of women feeling like they’re losing hair, I don’t think this is one of them Because I do think to an extent that this product does work. If you’re at a point where you need to try something for hair loss, I would use the growth serum. I would not use the minoxidil treatment until you are literally at your last straw. And nothing else has worked for you. Good luck ladies.

Also the consistency is great, it does not make your hair greasy at all. It does not make you have to wash your hair any earlier, it has a very very light scent that I don’t mind at all. When it’s wash day as soon as I get out of the shower while my hair is still wet I apply the product to my whole scalp. And then between wash days I apply the product every day only on my hairline. Because it is expensive and I use it very sparingly, mainly focusing on the hairline.
I’m going to continue using it, I intend on posting pictures later because I had taken one picture three months ago, and I took one picture today. And then I’ll take one picture probably three months from now.

title: The GRO Hair Serum Saved My Hair
body:
I have been using the GRO Hair Serum for 3 months now and it is the most effective product I have ever used. 

I have been waiting to review this product until now because I wanted to see if it could change my hair when all of the other products I tired couldn't. In the past and more recently I have been diagnosed with PCOS, Hypothyroidism, suspected SIBO and when I came off the hormonal birth control pill 7 months ago, all of my hair started to fall out. 

I was devastated and worried that it would get worse, but then I found this serum! I apply it every night on wet or dry hair and massage it in, it smells great and doesn't leave any residue or make my hair look greasy in the morning if applied on dry hair. 

I would highly recommend this product, especially if you are dealing with hormonal issues or an autoimmune disease.

title: It truly works!
body:
I bought this product when I realized I was having post COVID hair loss. I wanted a product that wouldn't be something I'd have to do for life and had solid reviews. This was the best product I found.

I'm 6 weeks in now. My hair loss slowed after about 3 weeks and has continued to slow since then. It's almost normal now. I have a MILLION baby hairs growing in. I cannot tell you what a relief it is after losing half of my hair. I was terrified it would be permanent and am greatly relieved it doesn't seem to be.

No only has the hair loss slowed dramatically and I have a million baby hairs, I cut my hair to hide the hair loss and my hair is growing like a weed! I was sad to cut 6 inches off my hair because I had worked so hard to grow it long. It's pretty darn exciting to see my hair growing so quickly.

title: Here’s a long one journey but with the best ending
body: This review is for the “skeptics” or the just came across this on Instagram and wants to confirm this is legit. So I am a 26 year old woman that had been suffering with hair loss since I was 16 years old. I had depleted all my avenues (so I thought) and began looking to a hair transplant. I had a biopsy done at 16 and was diagnosed with female pattern balding and was immediately thrown on spironolactone which was AWFUL and did nothing. After a year I stopped taking it and accepted this is what it would be ... I would just be bald by 30. I then looked into “toppers” however they would like your first born in order to pay for them and being 18 with little money that couldn’t happen and all the while I’m just losing my self confidence and tons of hair (two bald spots develop) I then heard about these “shots” to the scalp (that hurt like hell) that could help. So one year of that treatment (self paid thanks for nothing insurance) I have no results so once again I’m done and I’m scarred. I can’t even google hair loss solutions without crying and feeling terrible and lost. So like I said I started researching hair transplants and had no clue how I could pay for it but it was my “only solution” and then on day Vegamour pops up on my Instagram and I go read reviews because of course I’m skeptical and I liked what I read so I thought “what do I have to lose?” I promised myself I would give this a fair shot and that I did. In the first three months my hair grew five inches which usually takes me about TWO YEARS to do; however I wasn’t really seeing much improvement in my bald spots and thickness so after six months I chose to stop. During that two month period I noticed my hair had changed so much and I was losing more hair so I immediately ordered more hoping after another six months I would see a difference. Well I’m here one year later to tell you my hair hasn’t been this thick, this long, and this healthy since I was a teenager!!!! I’m gaining more and more confidence back daily by seeing my hair grow! I have these wild baby hairs all over that stand straight up but it’s 100% new growth. When I look into a mirror and no longer see my scalp I could honestly cry! This stuff has seriously changed my life and confidence so for that THANK YOU!!!!! And for those thinking about it DO IT! You will NOT regret it!!!!

I started using the vegamour serum about six months ago, and have been quite surprised by the results! By the third month, the bald spot at the back was already noticeably denser, and I started applying it more globally on my head. I have naturally quite thick hair, but the sides around my face have always been thinner, quite noticeably when my hair is in a ponytail and there are little baldish gaps. Now after 3 more months, my hair is getting denser everywhere I use the serum consistently! Not only is it clearly helping with growth, but my scalp and the grow-out I have now are the healthiest I've ever seen. My partner was so amazed by my results that he actually started using the serum himself for his own thinning spots! I'll be starting on the vitamins next month and am excited to see how that affects my results!

title: Works, but takes time!
body:
I decided to finish all three bottles of this serum over a period of three months before writing this review.
Bottom line: it works, but it takes time to work! 
I started to see a difference in hair growth within two weeks, and it's more obvious now after three months. The growth first began around my hairline with tons of new baby hairs sprouting. This was actually really interesting to see because I did NOT apply the serum to the hairline, but I guess the follicles in the hairline were stimulated and reacted first.
I have definitely noticed that my hair is thicker and that the spots that showed more scalp are slowly beginning to be covered with hair. Before, whenever I tied my hair, so much of my scalp would show, it would be so embarrassing! However, now there is less scalp showing and I think with continued usage, the results will improve. 
Additionally, I like the texture of this. This serum is really watery, so it's easy to spread and massage into the scalp and doesn't leave your hair oily.
The reason I didn't give it a full five stars is because this stuff is expensive and even when you use the amount they suggest in the directions, one bottle DOES NOT last one month.

body: I am in my late 40s and was losing my hair from the stress of my divorce. It made me so sad and frustrated, especially when potentially getting out into the singles scene again! I have some beautiful clip-in extensions, but the problem was, my hair had gotten too sparse to cover the top of them, so you could see I was wearing extensions (embarrassing). Like anyone stumbling on Vegamour or any hair product, I was skeptical, but I was hard pressed to find a bad review of this company or the Vegamour hair serum. And there were so many miraculous reviews, so I took a chance and tried it. Because I have to be extra gentle with my hair, I only wash it every 2-3 days, and because of the slight natural oils in this serum and my naturally oily scalp, I really only apply this when my hair is wet from being washed, so about every 2-3 days. In 5 months I can say I've had obvious results (although when I look at my latest "after" photo, I see I've been missing a spot lol) . In fact, I started using this just as my hair was growing out my color, so I can tell my hair has grown literally 4 inches in 8 months!! That's insane, typically it has taken me a couple of years to grow that out. And I can definitely say there is LESS fallen hair in the shower drain! It's woken my hair up and slowed its shedding significantly, giving me a chance to let the regrowth come in. I highly recommend you give it a try and use it every day if you can, I'm sure your results will be even better than mine.

title: This really works but you have to give it proper time!

I really need to write this review because my hair has been a life-long battle. I'm 39 and started using Rogain in high school when my hair started thinning at the part with a bald spot in back. I distinctly remember a family member teasing me I was going to go bald. Rogain never made my hair grow back but it did keep the loss at bay. Then at 37 my liver levels were elevated and my doctor told me that Rogain could be the culprit. I was crushed but stop using it and my hair thinned terribly....I was thinking i would be wearing wigs by 40.

I tried Vegamour thinking there is no way this could actually work but their guarantee made me feel safe trying. At 2 months I saw no difference...at 3 months I couldn't tell but the minute my hair dresser saw me she was like 'your hair looks thicker, what are you doing?' At about 5 months I suddenly started realizing I liked my hair, I no longer had huge thin and bald patches to be subconscious about. It had bounce and volume and I actually don't have a thin part...for the first time since age 14....I am completely shocked and I can't believe the confidence boost I have. It's end of July now I started using it last October.

Friends this is worth trying but don't judge it until at least 3 months in! I can't believe how much I love my hair now I never thought this was possible.

title: I finally See hair Growth!!
body: In April 2020 I was in the hospital with a life-threatening infection/abscess paired with a 103 fever, all caused by a fistula as a result of a crohns flare, I also had lost 40lbs on acct of being sick for 8 weeks leading up to my 11-day hospital stay. I had an IV of antibiotics and 3 surgeries, my body was stressed out beyond measure. About 2-3 weeks after I got out of the hospital I started to notice more and more hair fall out. Which I eventually realised I had Telogen Effluvium. It is your body's response to a trigger event (stress, sickness, surgery, child birth, anemia etc..), and can start 30-90 day after said trigger event and last usually from 3-6 months. Plus I had a lot of recovery ahead of me. Between then and now I believe I've lost about 50% or more of my hair density. I have fine hairs but a lot of them during normal times, so I'd say I have medium-thick hair. I lost the majority of my hair around my temples and in the back underneath, and that is where I always had my healthiest hair. I'm still having hair fall out a bit, but it appears to be tapering off. I've been using the GRO serum on my hair for the last 3 weeks, religiously twice a day, this being my 4th week now. I woke up this morning and I'm really seeing lots shoots of hair coming up in my front and my temples just today are noticeably denser. I've also paired this with a good consistent supplement routine, and ensuring I'm getting good quality nutrients from food as well. This product is great, I even sent side-by-side photos to my hair stylist, mom, and friends and they all were shocked by the difference. Thank you Vegamour! I can't wait to see the progress moving forward so I can share it with you all.
